      "text": "**It isn\u0027t an official sticker**—it\u0027s a fan-made or custom sticker created for platforms like Telegram, Discord, or VK. \n\nHere is what is going on:\n\n### 1. **Why it exists \u0026 the meme context**\n* The Russian text **«В ГЛАЗА СМОТРИ»** translates to **\"Look me in the eyes!\"**\n* It\u0027s a classic anime/NSFW meme trope where an intentionally provocative or bare-chested character demands that you maintain eye contact instead of staring at her chest.\n\n### 2. **Why you might see it used like a \"sticker\"**\n* Platforms like **Telegram** and **Discord** allow any user to upload custom sticker packs without pre-approval or strict content moderation. \n* Fans frequently draw high-quality anime art in the style of official game chibis/emotes and package them into custom user sticker sets, which makes them look surprisingly convincing until you notice the uncensored NSFW details.",
